description: 5th connection. 4th connection CONFIRMED SUCCESS: F0805A's output byte-for-byte identical to JU0300's, Q0805B's (via Q0805BH) byte-for-byte identical to ZA0500's, both also matching golden-master.md. This connection re-verifies F0805A/Q0805B after two further static-review-only fixes (found while writing the 08-05 lesson prose, not by a real compile/run, neither changes output against this repo's own 6-customer data): f0805as.rpgle's l2Break array-bounds guard (`if ix <= 49`, was incorrectly `if ix <> 49` - ju0300.rpg's own COMP 49 sets resulting indicator 90 at C-spec columns 54-55, which rpg400ref.txt confirms is the HIGH condition not EQUAL, so the guard's real meaning allows all 50 CT slots, not 49) and grandTotal's MISMATCH column (63, was 62 - ju0300.rpg's own O-spec end column for MISMATCH is 70, length 8, so 70-8+1=63, matching the same end-col-minus-length+1 rule every other field in this file follows). Neither fix is exercised by db/data/load_v1.sql's 6-customer data (never reaches IX 49/50, XFOOT always matches so MISMATCH never prints) - this connection can only confirm they still COMPILE cleanly, not that the fixed behavior is correct on real hardware (that would need >48 or =50 customers, or a deliberately mismatched XFOOT, neither of which this repo's own data provides). Also appends a read-only makei re-probe (MAKEICHECK, per advisor: check_dependencies() in makei's own script, read via head -60 in a prior connection, does a plain PATH substring test that this session's own exports satisfy - the 'startup files reset PATH' theory doesn't fit population the script's own logic - so this tests whether invoking makei from within an actual bash process, rather than from qsh directly, changes the result, which would show a qsh-vs-PASE-shell environment split matching every other finding in this part).

steps.label: CPJU03
steps.cmd:
DLTPGM PGM(&LIB/JU0300)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTRPGPGM PGM(&LIB/JU0300) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGSRC) SRCMBR(JU0300) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: CPF0805A
steps.cmd:
DLTPGM PGM(&LIB/F0805A)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTBNDRPG PGM(&LIB/F0805A) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(F0805A) DFTACTGRP(*NO) ACTGRP(*NEW) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: CPZA05
steps.cmd:
DLTPGM PGM(&LIB/ZA0500)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTRPGPGM PGM(&LIB/ZA0500) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGSRC) SRCMBR(ZA0500) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: CPJU09
steps.cmd:
DLTPGM PGM(&LIB/JU0900C)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTCLPGM PGM(&LIB/JU0900C) SRCFILE(&LIB/QCLSRC) SRCMBR(JU0900C) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: CPQ0805B
steps.cmd:
DLTPGM PGM(&LIB/Q0805B)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(&LIB/Q0805B) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(Q0805B) OBJTYPE(*PGM) COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: CPQ0805BH
steps.cmd:
DLTPGM PGM(&LIB/Q0805BH)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTCLPGM PGM(&LIB/Q0805BH) SRCFILE(&LIB/QCLSRC) SRCMBR(Q0805BH) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: MAKEICHECK
steps.cmd: echo ---VIA-QSH--- && export PATH=/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin:$PATH && makei --version 2>&1 && echo ---VIA-BASH--- && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/bash -c 'export PATH=/QOpenSys/pkgs/bin:$PATH; echo PATH=$PATH; makei --version' 2>&1
